title: WikiProject Manuscripts + HMO→Wikidata projection skill
goal: Judge whether an item is safe as a public Wikidata manuscript/person/work item using ALL supplied evidence channels (MARC + VIAF + Mazal + existing Wikidata + HMO Wikibase) under the WikiProject Manuscripts Data Model.
always: Manuscript item = physical carrier. Contained texts are exemplar of (P1574) → written work (Q47461344). NEVER put work authors as P50 on the manuscript.

Default P31 for manuscripts is manuscript (Q87167). Allowed replacements/additions when evidenced: illuminated manuscript (Q48498), palimpsest (Q274076 — never Q179808), manuscript fragment (Q30103158), Hebrew manuscript (Q115160920), composite manuscript (Q33308141), palm-leaf (Q1641020). Discouraged as primary P31: codex (Q213924), book (Q571).

Label priority (WPM fingerprint): (1) familiar trivial name → (2) canonical catalog code for a group → (3) library signature (city · institution · fonds · shelfmark). Description must not merely repeat the label.
Folio/page counts use P1104 (number of pages) with a leaf/folio unit when counting leaves — never P7416 as a quantity (P7416 is a citation folio qualifier).
Creation: inception P571, location of creation P1071, transcribed by P11603 (scribe), illustrator P110, annotator P11105, commissioned by P88, script style P9302.
Content: language P407 (qualify with P518 when needed), exemplar of P1574 (qualify with section/folio P958 / object named as P1932), genre P136 = intended use.
Housing: collection P195 = holding institution (preferred rank for current); owned by P127 for owners with time qualifiers; inventory number P217 = shelfmark; catalog code P528 with catalog P972.
Material: made from material P186 (papyrus/parchment/vellum/paper), state of conservation P5816, height P2048 / width P2049 when known.
Project Wikibase QIDs/PIDs (mhm-hmo.wikibase.cloud) are NOT Wikidata IDs. Public Wikidata claims require ontology-mapped P/Q or an explicit wikidata.org URI.
P2888 / P973 pointing at https://mhm-hmo.wikibase.cloud/wiki/Item:Q… are intentional HMO↔Wikidata bridges — do NOT fail solely because the URL is a project Wikibase page.
Evidence channels are complementary: MARC + VIAF + Mazal/NLI + existing Wikidata QID + HMO Wikibase pack. Do not report 'no evidence' when any non-empty channel supports the claim.
Be fail-closed: unsupported semantic claims → omit or fail; do not invent QIDs from memory.

wikidata: Attend to EVERY evidence pack in the prompt: MARC slice, VIAF, Mazal/NLI, existing Wikidata, HMO Wikibase, plus labels/descriptions, P31, P1574 chain, agent roles, housing/identifiers, validation_issues, work_candidate_evidence, local_reference_targets.
Pass only when public Wikidata statements are evidence-backed (from any channel) and role-correct under the Data Model.
Partial when mostly safe but removable bad claims remain.
Do not fail an item solely for 'No MARC context' when VIAF/Mazal/Wikidata/Wikibase packs are present — use those packs; note MARC absence only as a caveat.
hmo: Attend to: entity_type (not class_qid as Wikidata), labels/descriptions, claims that would map via HMO→Wikidata bridge, SHACL, MARC/control_numbers, authority identifiers.
Ask: if this HMO item were projected to public Wikidata, would it violate WPM (P50-on-MS, wrong P31, project-QID-as-Wikidata, folio misuse, invented holder)?
Structural/epistemology HMO entities are HMO-only — do not demand Wikidata manuscript fingerprint completeness.
Manuscript/Person/Work/Place HMO entities SHOULD be Wikidata-projection-ready when evidence exists.

manuscript: Fingerprint: signature / shelfmark / trivial name; English label only with trusted romanization; never invent NLI ownership in the description.
P195 only with verified current-holder organization QID — absence of holder ≠ National Library of Israel collection.
P1574 links works present in the MS; qualify with section/folio (P958) when known. Authors of those works live on the WORK item (P50), not on the MS.
P48498 (illuminated) only with confirmed illumination/decoration evidence — MARC 'Illustrated works' alone is insufficient.
Identifiers: prefer stable catalog IDs (e.g. NLI / P3959); IIIF = P6108 when present; HMO bridge via browseable Item:Q P2888/P973 is expected for canonical projection.
person: P31 human (Q5) for persons; organizations are E74_Group / organization — never emit a corporate body as human.
Prefer VIAF (P214), NLI J9U (P8189), birth/death when authority-exact; inverted Surname, Given may stay as alias with natural-order label.
Scribes appear on manuscripts via P11603, not as manuscript P50.
VIAF + Mazal packs are first-class even when the compact MARC slice is empty for a shared person across manuscripts.
work: P31 written work (Q47461344) (or evidenced subclass). Author = P50 on the WORK; unresolved authors may be P2093 or deferred local P50 targets.
Title language (P1476) follows the title script. Works do not inherit manuscript P407 casually.
Reject catalogue prose, dedications, geography fragments, and unverified Latin-only 505 headings without authority/QID.
work_candidate_evidence + accepted Mazal/Wikidata work rows ground CREATE works; do not demand a live QID when the evidence pack accepts a local work.
place: Places need coordinates or a stable external id when asserted; Wikidata place QID must be a real wikidata.org id, never a project Wikibase Q-number.
Creation place on manuscripts is P1071, not a free-text dump into the description alone.
hmo_structural: CatalogStep / Evidence* / PhilologicalView / paradigm individuals are HMO epistemology — Wikidata projection is out of scope.
Judge HMO label/description honesty + SHACL; do not fail for missing WPM manuscript properties.
hmo_event: E12_Production / Time-Span / TransmissionWitness / TextTradition use intentional English system labels; require substantive descriptions (or honest-negative 'not recorded').
Public Wikidata does not mint a separate Production item for every MS — projection maps production facts onto the manuscript (P571/P1071/P11603).

claim_triggers.P50: If entity is a manuscript: P50 on manuscript is a HARD FAIL (use P1574→work→P50). If entity is a work: P50 is correct when author evidence exists.
claim_triggers.P7416: P7416 as a quantity/count is a HARD FAIL. Folio counts → P1104 (+ leaf unit). P7416 only as a citation folio qualifier.
claim_triggers.P31: Check P31 against the allowed manuscript classes; Q179808 is never palimpsest; Q5 on a manuscript is wrong; Hebrew manuscript Q115160920 is allowed when evidenced.
claim_triggers.P195: Require verified holder evidence; do not accept placeholder Unknown Library or default-NLI without evidence.
claim_triggers.P1574: Expected on manuscripts that contain named works; authors belong on the linked work, not on the MS via P50.
claim_triggers.P1104: Accept leaf/folio quantity modeling; do not demand P7416 for counts.
claim_triggers.P11603: Scribe must be a person item, not an institution.
claim_triggers.P921: Primary subject only — not every 650 note; broad headings like 'Jews' need primary-subject evidence.
claim_triggers.P136: Genre/use — do not equate 'illustrated' MARC genre with illuminated manuscript P31.
claim_triggers.P7535: Archival-collection scope only — not arbitrary catalog notes.
claim_triggers.P2888: exact match / same as: a browseable mhm-hmo.wikibase.cloud Item:Q URL is an intentional project bridge — accept when the HMO Wikibase pack agrees; reject ontology IRIs or dead /wiki/MS_ slugs.
claim_triggers.P973: described at URL: same bridge policy as P2888 for the project Wikibase Item page.
claim_triggers.P214: VIAF ID — treat VIAF pack / P214 as strong person identity evidence.
claim_triggers.P8189: NLI / Mazal person id — treat Mazal pack / P8189 as strong identity evidence.
claim_triggers.P186: Writing support / material — papyrus, parchment, vellum, paper when MARC or HMO claims support it.
claim_triggers.P9302: Script style — accept when paleography evidence exists; do not invent.

hmo_to_wikidata_checklist: Map only allowlisted ontology local-names → public PIDs (hmo_wikidata_pq_mapper).
Never copy project Wikibase P/Q numbers into Wikidata statements by numeric identity.
Manuscript agents: scribe→P11603, author of contained work→work P50, owner→P127, holder→P195.
HMO-only philology (stemma, paradigm bridges, epistemology steps) MUST NOT become speculative public claims.
External Wikidata URIs on HMO entities may become P2888/exact-match style links when the mapper allows — never treat a local Q1370 as Wikidata Q1370.
Browseable HMO Item:Q pages on P2888/P973 are correct bridges; ontology#MS_… IRIs and /wiki/MS_… slugs are not.
